DOUBLE_DAMAGE.name: Double Damage
DOUBLE_DAMAGE.text: Your Attacks deal double damage this turn.

DRAW_REDUCTION.name: Draw Reduction
DRAW_REDUCTION.text: You draw 1 fewer card next turn.

FRAIL.name: Frail
FRAIL.text: You gain 25% less Block from cards. Decreases by 1 at the end of your turn.

INTANGIBLE.name: Intangible
INTANGIBLE.text: All damage and HP loss you take is reduced to 1. Decreases by 1 at the end of your turn.

VULNERABLE.name: Vulnerable
VULNERABLE.text: You take 50% more damage from attacks. Decreases by 1 at the end of your turn.

WEAK.name: Weak
WEAK.text: Your Attacks deal 25% less damage. Decreases by 1 at the end of your turn.

BIAS.name: Bias
BIAS.text: At the start of each turn, lose X Focus.

CONFUSED.name: Confused
CONFUSED.text: The cost of every card you draw is randomized (0-3) for the rest of combat.

CONSTRICTED.name: Constricted
CONSTRICTED.text: At the end of your turn, take X damage.

ENTANGLED.name: Entangled
ENTANGLED.text: You cannot play Attacks this turn.

FASTING.name: Fasting
FASTING.text: You gain X less Energy at the start of each turn.

HEX.name: Hex
HEX.text: Whenever you play a non-Attack card, shuffle a Dazed into your draw pile.

LOSE_DEXTERITY.name: Lose Dexterity
LOSE_DEXTERITY.text: At the end of your turn, lose X Dexterity.

LOSE_STRENGTH.name: Lose Strength
LOSE_STRENGTH.text: At the end of your turn, lose X Strength.

NO_BLOCK.name: No Block
NO_BLOCK.text: You cannot gain Block from cards this turn.

NO_DRAW.name: No Draw
NO_DRAW.text: You cannot draw any more cards this turn.

WRAITH_FORM.name: Wraith Form
WRAITH_FORM.text: At the end of your turn, lose X Dexterity.

BARRICADE.name: Barricade
BARRICADE.text: Your Block is not removed at the start of your turn.

BLASPHEMER.name: Blasphemer
BLASPHEMER.text: You die at the start of your next turn.

CORRUPTION.name: Corruption
CORRUPTION.text: Skills cost 0. Whenever you play a Skill, Exhaust it.

ELECTRO.name: Electro
ELECTRO.text: Your Lightning orbs hit ALL enemies.

SURROUNDED.name: Surrounded
SURROUNDED.text: You are surrounded: enemies you are not facing deal 50% more damage to you.
SURROUNDED.engine_note: the engine treats the last enemy you targeted as the one you face.

MASTER_REALITY.name: Master Reality
MASTER_REALITY.text: Cards created during combat enter play Upgraded.

PEN_NIB.name: Pen Nib
PEN_NIB.text: Your next Attack deals double damage.

WRATH_NEXT_TURN.name: Wrath Next Turn
WRATH_NEXT_TURN.text: You enter Wrath at the start of your next turn.

AMPLIFY.name: Amplify
AMPLIFY.text: Your next X Power cards are played twice.

BLUR.name: Blur
BLUR.text: Your Block is not removed at the start of your next X turns.

BUFFER.name: Buffer
BUFFER.text: Prevent the next X times you would lose HP.

COLLECT.name: Collect
COLLECT.text: At the start of each of your next X turns, put a Miracle into your hand.
COLLECT.engine_note: the game puts in a Miracle+; the engine puts in a plain Miracle.

DOUBLE_TAP.name: Double Tap
DOUBLE_TAP.text: Your next X Attacks are played twice.

DUPLICATION.name: Duplication
DUPLICATION.text: Your next X cards are played twice.

ECHO_FORM.name: Echo Form
ECHO_FORM.text: The first X cards you play each turn are played twice.

REBOUND.name: Rebound
REBOUND.text: The next X cards you play this turn go on top of your draw pile instead of your discard pile.

MANTRA.name: Mantra
MANTRA.text: At 10 Mantra you enter Divinity and Mantra resets. (X so far)

ACCURACY.name: Accuracy
ACCURACY.text: Your Shivs deal X additional damage.

AFTER_IMAGE.name: After Image
AFTER_IMAGE.text: Whenever you play a card, gain X Block.

BATTLE_HYMN.name: Battle Hymn
BATTLE_HYMN.text: At the start of each turn, add X Smite to your hand.

BRUTALITY.name: Brutality
BRUTALITY.text: At the start of your turn, lose X HP and draw X cards.

BURST.name: Burst
BURST.text: Your next X Skills are played twice.

COMBUST.name: Combust
COMBUST.text: At the end of your turn, lose 1 HP per Combust played and deal X damage to ALL enemies.

CREATIVE_AI.name: Creative AI
CREATIVE_AI.text: At the start of your turn, add X random Power cards to your hand.

DARK_EMBRACE.name: Dark Embrace
DARK_EMBRACE.text: Whenever a card is Exhausted, draw X cards.

DEMON_FORM.name: Demon Form
DEMON_FORM.text: At the start of your turn, gain X Strength.

DEVA.name: Deva
DEVA.text: At the start of your turn, gain Energy, then increase that gain by X.

DEVOTION.name: Devotion
DEVOTION.text: At the start of your turn, gain X Mantra.

DRAW_CARD_NEXT_TURN.name: Draw Card Next Turn
DRAW_CARD_NEXT_TURN.text: Draw X additional cards next turn.

ENERGIZED.name: Energized
ENERGIZED.text: Gain X additional Energy next turn.

ENVENOM.name: Envenom
ENVENOM.text: Whenever you deal unblocked attack damage, apply X Poison to that enemy.

ESTABLISHMENT.name: Establishment
ESTABLISHMENT.text: Whenever a card is Retained, its cost is reduced by X for the rest of combat.

EVOLVE.name: Evolve
EVOLVE.text: Whenever you draw a Status card, draw X cards.

FEEL_NO_PAIN.name: Feel No Pain
FEEL_NO_PAIN.text: Whenever a card is Exhausted, gain X Block.

FIRE_BREATHING.name: Fire Breathing
FIRE_BREATHING.text: Whenever you draw a Status or Curse card, deal X damage to ALL enemies.

FLAME_BARRIER.name: Flame Barrier
FLAME_BARRIER.text: When you are attacked, deal X damage back. Wears off at the start of your next turn.

FOCUS.name: Focus
FOCUS.text: Your orbs are X more effective. (Negative Focus weakens them.)

FORESIGHT.name: Foresight
FORESIGHT.text: At the start of your turn, Scry X.

HELLO_WORLD.name: Hello World
HELLO_WORLD.text: At the start of your turn, add a random Common card to your hand.
HELLO_WORLD.engine_note: not implemented (the engine removes the power instead).

INFINITE_BLADES.name: Infinite Blades
INFINITE_BLADES.text: At the start of your turn, add X Shivs to your hand.

JUGGERNAUT.name: Juggernaut
JUGGERNAUT.text: Whenever you gain Block, deal X damage to a random enemy.

LIKE_WATER.name: Like Water
LIKE_WATER.text: At the end of your turn, if you are in Calm, gain X Block.

LOOP.name: Loop
LOOP.text: At the start of your turn, trigger the passive of your first orb X additional times.

MAGNETISM.name: Magnetism
MAGNETISM.text: At the start of your turn, add X random Colorless cards to your hand.

MAYHEM.name: Mayhem
MAYHEM.text: At the start of your turn, play the top X cards of your draw pile.

METALLICIZE.name: Metallicize
METALLICIZE.text: At the end of your turn, gain X Block.

NEXT_TURN_BLOCK.name: Next Turn Block
NEXT_TURN_BLOCK.text: Gain X Block at the start of your next turn.

NOXIOUS_FUMES.name: Noxious Fumes
NOXIOUS_FUMES.text: At the start of your turn, apply X Poison to ALL enemies.

OMEGA.name: Omega
OMEGA.text: At the end of your turn, deal X damage to ALL enemies.

PANACHE.name: Panache
PANACHE.text: Every 5 cards you play, deal X damage to ALL enemies.

PHANTASMAL.name: Phantasmal
PHANTASMAL.text: For the next X turns, your Attacks deal double damage.

PLATED_ARMOR.name: Plated Armor
PLATED_ARMOR.text: At the end of your turn, gain X Block. Loses 1 stack whenever you take unblocked attack damage.

RAGE.name: Rage
RAGE.text: Whenever you play an Attack this turn, gain X Block.

REGEN.name: Regen
REGEN.text: At the end of your turn, heal X HP, then Regeneration decreases by 1.

RITUAL.name: Ritual
RITUAL.text: At the end of your turn, gain X Strength.

RUPTURE.name: Rupture
RUPTURE.text: Whenever you lose HP from a card, gain X Strength.

SADISTIC.name: Sadistic
SADISTIC.text: Whenever you apply a debuff to an enemy, deal X damage to it.

STATIC_DISCHARGE.name: Static Discharge
STATIC_DISCHARGE.text: Whenever you take unblocked attack damage, Channel X Lightning.

THORNS.name: Thorns
THORNS.text: When you are attacked, deal X damage back to the attacker.

THOUSAND_CUTS.name: Thousand Cuts
THOUSAND_CUTS.text: Whenever you play a card, deal X damage to ALL enemies.

TOOLS_OF_THE_TRADE.name: Tools of the Trade
TOOLS_OF_THE_TRADE.text: At the start of your turn, draw X cards and discard X cards.
TOOLS_OF_THE_TRADE.engine_note: the engine draws but never asks you to discard.

VIGOR.name: Vigor
VIGOR.text: Your next Attack deals X additional damage, then Vigor is removed.

WAVE_OF_THE_HAND.name: Wave of the Hand
WAVE_OF_THE_HAND.text: Whenever you gain Block this turn, apply X Weak to ALL enemies.

EQUILIBRIUM.name: Equilibrium
EQUILIBRIUM.text: Your hand is Retained for the next X turns.
EQUILIBRIUM.engine_note: the engine retains the hand but does not force Ethereal cards to stay.

ARTIFACT.name: Artifact
ARTIFACT.text: Negates the next X debuffs applied to you.

DEXTERITY.name: Dexterity
DEXTERITY.text: You gain X additional Block from cards. (Negative Dexterity reduces it.)

STRENGTH.name: Strength
STRENGTH.text: Your Attacks deal X additional damage per hit. (Negative Strength reduces it.)

THE_BOMB.name: The Bomb
THE_BOMB.text: At the end of 3 turns, deal X damage to ALL enemies.
THE_BOMB.engine_note: not implemented — the engine stores the damage but never detonates it.

ARTIFACT.name: Artifact
ARTIFACT.text: Negates the next X debuffs applied to this enemy.

BLOCK_RETURN.name: Block Return
BLOCK_RETURN.text: Whenever you attack this enemy, you gain X Block.
BLOCK_RETURN.engine_note: inert — nothing in the engine applies it.

CHOKED.name: Choked
CHOKED.text: Whenever you play a card this turn, this enemy loses X HP.

CORPSE_EXPLOSION.name: Corpse Explosion
CORPSE_EXPLOSION.text: When this enemy dies, deal damage equal to X times its Max HP to ALL enemies.

LOCK_ON.name: Lock On
LOCK_ON.text: Lightning and Dark orbs deal 50% more damage to this enemy. Decreases by 1 each round.

MARK.name: Mark
MARK.text: Whenever you play Pressure Points, this enemy loses X HP.

METALLICIZE.name: Metallicize
METALLICIZE.text: At the end of its turn, this enemy gains X Block.

PLATED_ARMOR.name: Plated Armor
PLATED_ARMOR.text: At the end of its turn, this enemy gains X Block. Loses 1 stack whenever it takes unblocked attack damage.

POISON.name: Poison
POISON.text: At the start of its turn, this enemy loses X HP, then Poison decreases by 1.

REGEN.name: Regen
REGEN.text: At the start of its turn, this enemy heals X HP.

SHACKLED.name: Shackled
SHACKLED.text: This enemy has lost X Strength; it regains that Strength at the end of its turn.

STRENGTH.name: Strength
STRENGTH.text: This enemy's attacks deal X additional damage per hit. (Negative Strength reduces it.)

VULNERABLE.name: Vulnerable
VULNERABLE.text: This enemy takes 50% more damage from attacks. Decreases by 1 each round.

WEAK.name: Weak
WEAK.text: This enemy's attacks deal 25% less damage. Decreases by 1 each round.

ANGRY.name: Angry
ANGRY.text: Whenever this enemy takes attack damage, it gains X Strength.

BEAT_OF_DEATH.name: Beat of Death
BEAT_OF_DEATH.text: Whenever you play a card, you take X damage.

CURIOSITY.name: Curiosity
CURIOSITY.text: Whenever you play a Power card, this enemy gains X Strength.

CURL_UP.name: Curl Up
CURL_UP.text: The first time this enemy takes attack damage, it gains X Block and loses this power.

ENRAGE.name: Enrage
ENRAGE.text: Whenever you play a Skill, this enemy gains X Strength.

FADING.name: Fading
FADING.text: This enemy dies in X turns.

FLIGHT.name: Flight
FLIGHT.text: Attack damage to this enemy is halved. Each hit removes 1 stack; at 0 it is stunned for a turn.

GENERIC_STRENGTH_UP.name: Generic Strength Up
GENERIC_STRENGTH_UP.text: At the end of each round, this enemy gains X Strength.

INTANGIBLE.name: Intangible
INTANGIBLE.text: All damage this enemy takes is reduced to 1.
INTANGIBLE.engine_note: the engine always decrements it at the end of the round, unlike the game.

MALLEABLE.name: Malleable
MALLEABLE.text: Whenever this enemy takes attack damage, it gains X Block; X grows by 1 per hit and resets to 3 each turn.

MODE_SHIFT.name: Mode Shift
MODE_SHIFT.text: After taking X more damage, this enemy shifts to its defensive mode.

RITUAL.name: Ritual
RITUAL.text: At the end of each round, this enemy gains X Strength (skipping the round it was applied).

SLOW.name: Slow
SLOW.text: This enemy takes 10% more damage for each card you played this turn. Resets each round.

SPORE_CLOUD.name: Spore Cloud
SPORE_CLOUD.text: When this enemy dies, you gain X Vulnerable.

THIEVERY.name: Thievery
THIEVERY.text: This enemy steals X gold whenever it attacks you.

THORNS.name: Thorns
THORNS.text: Whenever you attack this enemy, you take X damage.

TIME_WARP.name: Time Warp
TIME_WARP.text: Whenever you play 12 cards, this enemy gains 2 Strength and your turn ends. (X so far)

INVINCIBLE.name: Invincible
INVINCIBLE.text: This enemy can lose at most X more HP this turn.

REACTIVE.name: Reactive
REACTIVE.text: Whenever this enemy takes attack damage, it changes its intent.

SHARP_HIDE.name: Sharp Hide
SHARP_HIDE.text: Whenever you play an Attack, you take X damage.

ASLEEP.name: Asleep
ASLEEP.text: This enemy is asleep: it does not act, and waking it removes its Metallicize.

BARRICADE.name: Barricade
BARRICADE.text: This enemy's Block is not removed at the start of its turn.

MINION.name: Minion
MINION.text: This enemy is a minion; it flees when its leader dies.

MINION_LEADER.name: Minion Leader
MINION_LEADER.text: Killing this enemy ends the fight.

PAINFUL_STABS.name: Painful Stabs
PAINFUL_STABS.text: Whenever this enemy deals unblocked attack damage, a Wound is shuffled into your discard pile.

REGROW.name: Regrow
REGROW.text: When this enemy dies, it revives with full HP.

SHIFTING.name: Shifting
SHIFTING.text: Whenever this enemy takes damage, it loses that much Strength until the end of its turn.

STASIS.name: Stasis
STASIS.text: This enemy holds a card of yours; it returns to your discard pile when the enemy dies.
